CloudBusinessSnapshot.title: CloudBusinessSnapshot
CloudBusinessSnapshot.description: Cloud synchronized snapshot of a FastRest POS branch or retail store with summary metrics and full backup bundle.

businessId.description: Unique identifier for the tenant business or branch.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated owner/admin who synced this branch.

ownerEmail.description: Email of the owner who synced the branch.

businessName.description: Display name of the restaurant or retail store.

currency.description: Currency symbol used in the branch.

ordersCount.description: Total number of sale orders stored in the branch snapshot.

totalRevenueMinor.description: Total revenue in minor currency units (piastres).

openShiftsCount.description: Number of currently open cashier shifts.

bundle.description: Native map containing the full BusinessBackupBundle data for offline restoration and cross-device sync.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the branch record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the branch record was last synced.

/cloud_businesses/{businessId}.description: Stores cloud-synchronized POS branch snapshots isolated by ownerUid and businessId.
